items.q: How is each note written and reviewed?
items.a: A named Aquemi engineer writes it from a question we are asked on projects, and a second engineer checks it before publication. Each claim names the standard, clause and edition; numbers carry their units. The note shows its publication date and date of last review. [Named author for each topic group]

items.q: Can we cite a note in our validation documents?
items.a: Cite the standard, not the note. A note is our reading of the clause, with the clause number so you can check it. Your quality unit decides how the standard applies to your site.

items.q: What happens when a standard changes after a note is published?
items.a: We review the note against the new text, update it and change its date of last review. If the answer changes, the note says what changed and when, and subscribers to that topic get the update. Errors are fixed in place with a dated correction line, never silently.
